name: Social Champ
description: Social Champ brings your social media workflow into Claude. Connect your Social Champ account to view channels and workspaces, draft AI-assisted content, schedule and update posts, manage calendars and queues, collaborate on approvals, and organize media and post labels. Actions apply only to the Social Champ workspaces and connected channels you authorize.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Social Champ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Social Champ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.socialchamp.com/mcp/claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Social Champ MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Social Champ lists 43 MCP tools, including approval_approve, approval_assign, approval_list_pending, approval_reject, bulk_delete, bulk_label, bulk_schedule, complete_media_upload, create_image_post, create_media_upload, create_public_calendar_link, and create_text_post.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Social Champ?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Social Champ in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Social Champ MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Social Champ requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Social Champ is developed by Social Champ. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
